note.en: Representative ideal MHD with magnetic permeability set to one. E is total thermal, kinetic and magnetic energy density. Follow CT/GLM, divergence conventions and HLLD tests.

name.en: Magnetic loop: independent 2D reference and refinement

note.en: Compare genuine 2D magnetic-loop transport with final conserved fields from independent Athena++, qualified in space and time.

title.ja: 磁場ループ：固定Athena++の独立終端参照
title.en: Magnetic loop: pinned independent Athena++ final-field reference

assumptions.ja: [-1,1]×[-.5,.5]周期、ρ=p=1、Az=.001max(.3−r,0)、T=1、(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32)。変更していない公式生成器と同じv=(2,1,2)で、古いvz=0設定とは区別します。未変更の公式生成器を固定コミット1395e2f…で実行し、Ny64/128と最細格子CFL半減で参照感度を確認します。比較は終端保存場のみで、保守的な粗視化後に評価します。
assumptions.en: Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs. Execute the unchanged official generator at pinned commit1395e2f…; qualify Ny64/128 and finest-grid half-CFL sensitivity. Compare final conserved fields only after conservative restriction.

note.en: Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs.

reference_note.ja: 弱磁場ループが1周期で戻る初期場との誤差、磁気エネルギー、配置固有の磁場発散を確認します。任意強度のMHDループの厳密解を主張しません。 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。Athena++の2格子と刻み半減で参照を検定。終端保存変数を保守的に粗視化し、誤差と参照感度を分離します。共通セル発散と主計算の固有面発散は別の検査です。
reference_note.en: Check return error against the initial weak-field loop, magnetic energy and layout-specific divergence after one transit. No exact solution is claimed for arbitrary finite-strength MHD loops. Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify Athena++ with two grids and a half-CFL probe. Conservatively restrict final conserved states and separate reference sensitivity from primary error. Common-cell divergence and primary native-face divergence are distinct checks.

method_note.ja: この問題の保存済み比較データまたは対応する公開検査で使われる手法です。一般的な適用可能性だけでは追加していません。
method_note.en: Methods used by this problem’s stored comparison data or corresponding public checks, rather than added solely for general applicability.

scope.ja: 実際の2次元磁場ループ輸送を、別実装Athena++の空間・時間感度を検査した終端保存場と比較します。
scope.en: Compare genuine 2D magnetic-loop transport with final conserved fields from independent Athena++, qualified in space and time.

assumptions.en: Periodic[-1,1]x[-.5,.5],rho=p1,Az=.001max(.3-r,0),T1,(Nx,Ny)=(16,8),(32,16),(64,32). Use unchanged official-generator v=(2,1,2), explicitly distinct from old vz0 inputs.

limits.ja: 少数の固定入力に対する教育用検証です。HLLDのHLLE代替と再構成の正値性スケーリングを数え、セル状態の床・クリップ・再試行は行いません。有限格子参照は厳密解ではなく、任意問題の安定性・正値性や普遍的次数を保証しません。独立比較は終端のみ。中間Athena時刻は指定四半時刻直後で、正確に整列した場とは表示しません。Athenaの固有面発散は出力しておらず測定を主張しません。密度比は圧縮の診断であり数学的衝撃波の証明ではありません。
limits.en: Educational fixed inputs only. Count HLLD-to-HLLE fallbacks and face reconstruction positivity scaling; no cell floor/clipping/retry. Finite-grid references are not exact solutions; no universal stability, positivity or order guarantee. Independent comparisons are final-only. Intermediate Athena outputs occur just after requested quarter times and are not matched frames. Athena native-face divergence is not exported/measured. Density contrast diagnoses compression, not a mathematical proof of shock formation.

reference_note.ja: 実行前契約で47pytest・全12計算を固定。3格子と最細格子の時間刻み半減を分離し、全段の正値性・有限性、保存量、Courant数、5時刻の実場を保存します。Athena++の2格子と刻み半減で参照を検定。終端保存変数を保守的に粗視化し、誤差と参照感度を分離します。共通セル発散と主計算の固有面発散は別の検査です。
reference_note.en: Freeze 47 pytest checks and12 primary runs before execution. Separate three grids and a finest-grid half-dt probe; retain stage positivity/finiteness, conservation, Courant number and five actual field snapshots. Qualify Athena++ with two grids and a half-CFL probe. Conservatively restrict final conserved states and separate reference sensitivity from primary error. Common-cell divergence and primary native-face divergence are distinct checks.
